decision: Use a conventional two-ended six-feature CSP and default SVD LDA as a NEW secondary contextual reference for the Lee2019 extension.
difference_from_archived_reference: The archived binary expression np.r_[:3, -3:] selected only the first three filters. This Lee reference explicitly selects [0,1,2,n_channels-3,n_channels-2,n_channels-1], six distinct filters, and is disclosed as a new reference.
spatial_fit_data: Day 1 only; no day-2 signal or label is passed to fit_csp.
covariance: Arithmetic mean of np.cov(trial) for each day-1 class, without trace normalization or shrinkage.
whitening: Eigenvectors of cov_left + cov_right, eigenvalues descending, eigenvalue floor 1e-10.
selection: Three largest and three smallest eigenvalues of the whitened left-hand covariance.
features: Six log population variances, np.log(np.var(W @ trial, axis=1)); no additional feature scaling.

metrics.NLL: mean negative log true-class probability clipped to [1e-12,1]
metrics.ECE: 15 equal-width bins, matching released EEGNet core

full_data_access_condition: Root freezes the study protocol and supplies its SHA256 before this runner opens day-2 inputs.
progress_output: Completion per subject only; no interim condition comparison.
resume: Reuse only participant JSON with matching protocol/script, metadata and input NPZ hashes, prediction hash, dimensions and class order. Preserve orphan prediction exports in recovery/ before recomputing; reject any changed completed identity.
